title: Asian Games: Alas beach pair Buytrago, Rosales out of medal race

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas men’s beach volleyball pair James Buytrago and Ronniel Rosales bowed out of the Asian Games medal contention after losing to unbeaten Bintang Akbar and Sofyan Rachman Efendi of Indonesia, 11-21, 13-21, on Sunday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Buytrago and Rosales couldn’t save their campaign, as the Indonesians were too much and dominated their way to a Pool C sweep.
